text:
tanya: noticed a sawtooth pattern in decode p95 after the runtime patch roll at 03:42 UTC
matt: same. decode tail pops every ~90s, correlates with larger prefill batches on a subset of racks
infra-bot: canary deployed: gpu-kernel-chooser v2 -> canary at 2026-03-12T03:42:11Z
smitha: grab of a quick perf profile (top symbols):
```
prefill_dispatcher 52% kernel_selection
kv_eviction_worker 28% kv_evict
decode_lane_wait 14% handshake_wait
other 6%
```
tanya: kv eviction rate on the hot racks jumps ~3.5x in the 99th percentile
matt: I also noticed `prefill_token_target` was increased from 56 -> 96 in that canary bundle
smitha: larger prefill target changes batch geometry; when prefill grabs many KV slots, decodes land on cold KV and stall
ops-bot: alert: decode_p95 > 1200ms on rack-r3 for 8m
smitha: hypothesis: prefill batch length + contiguous prefill streaks are starving decode lanes and thrashing KV LRU
matt: mitigation idea: back off global prefill target and introduce a per-worker consecutive_prefill_limit + KV priming window for decode
tanya: also consider introducing a "prefill preemption" token — allow decode flows to preempt queued prefill batches if their wait exceeds X ms
smitha: put together a quick staging patch:
```
runtime.cfg {
  prefill_token_target: 48
  max_consecutive_prefills: 2
  handshake_ms_threshold: 4
  preemption_wait_ms: 8
}
```
smitha: ran a 15m replay on staging using harvest-2026-03-10.trace (concurrency=250)
```
./perf-replay --trace=harvest-2026-03-10.trace --concurrency=250 --duration=15m --seed=2026
```
smitha: staging results: decode p95 -20%, decode p99 -38%, kv-evict-rate tail - from 5.2% -> 1.1%
matt: good. did you also capture kernel selection histograms?
smitha: yes — kernel_switch_count down 40% on staging; fewer large-batch kernel handoffs
tanya: next steps: 1) hold canary rollback if metric doesn't improve, 2) push config change to canary subset of prod (10% racks), 3) run longer 2h replay and collect full KV traces, 4) file regression with kernel diff and traces
matt: filed regression INF-2891 with links to flame graphs and KV traces
ops-bot: scheduled: 2h canary rollout to racks [r1-r10] at 2026-03-13T00:30:00Z (eng-sre + eng-runtime tagged)
smitha: one more idea: add a lightweight KV-affinity hint for small decodes so they hit primed slots where possible — will prototype after canary
tanya: ok, let's watch the canary. I'll keep dashboards open and post alerts to this thread
matt: thanks — if we still see oscillation we can try prefill adaptive decay (reduce token target after N prefill wins)
smitha: noted. committing staging patch to branch `runtime/prefill-safety-2026-03` and will attach replay artifacts
tanya: excellent. dropping a short checklist in INF-2891 and linking the replay command + graphs
smitha: replay artifacts: https://s3.redwood.internal/perf/inf-2891/replay-2026-03-12.tar.gz
ops-bot: monitoring enabled for canary: decode_p95, kv_evictions, kernel_switch_count, prefill_streaks
matt: ping here with any anomalies :thumbsup:
